name: Prospector
role: Old diggers down from the badlands
about: Talkative, half-cracked from years alone with a mule; sly about where the colour is.

say: You ain't following me, are ya?
and all I got is a bad back and a worse mule.
Spare a dollar for an old man?
There's crates of blasting powder out in them red rocks.
Vulture Ridge boys camp up in the badlands.
I give 'em a wide berth and so should you.
River's only crossable at the two bridges.
Tried fording it once. Lost the mule. Got him back.
I ain't got no gold! I swear it!
